tools.name: get_download_links
tools.description: Return the canonical cloud signup URL users should visit before getting desktop app access. Read-only; does not navigate.

tools.name: get_pricing_summary
tools.description: Return OpenWork's pricing tiers, what each includes, and the CTA destination. Read-only; does not navigate.

tools.name: navigate_to
tools.description: Navigate the current tab to a key section of openworklabs.com. Use this when the user expresses intent to view pricing, download, enterprise, cloud, docs, trust, or feedback.

destination.description: The named section to navigate to.

tools.name: open_enterprise_contact
tools.description: Navigate to the Enterprise page and scroll to the book-a-call section. Use this when the user wants to talk to sales or needs SSO, audit, or procurement support.
